title: Keto Wine Night Board
seo_title: Keto Wine and Cheese Board: Shopping List & Pairings
description: A keto wine night board for 6: brie, aged Gouda, blue cheese, prosciutto, soppressata, bresaola, endive, olives, walnuts, blackberries and dark chocolate.
hook: Three cheeses, three cured meats, one good bottle: a wine and cheese night that fits a keto week.
why: The classic wine and cheese trio is already keto: soft brie, crunchy aged Gouda and a blue. Prosciutto, soppressata and bresaola cover delicate, spicy and lean.

Endive takes the place of crackers, walnuts and blackberries add the sweet-bitter notes blue cheese loves, and a few squares of 90% dark chocolate finish it. Dry wines are lowest in carbs. About 5 g net carbs per serving.

timeline.what: Take out the aged gouda and blue.
Take out the brie. Separate the endive leaves.
Take out the meats. Open the red wine.

faq.a: Dry wines have the least sugar: dry sparkling, Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Grigio, Pinot Noir and Cabernet are typical choices. Sweet and dessert wines are the ones to skip.

faq.q: What goes with blue cheese on a keto board?
faq.a: Walnuts, blackberries, dark chocolate and endive.
About 5 g net carbs per serving for 6, not counting the wine.
